title: The origin of the back injury
archive: The origin of the back injury
what_we_know: A sworn statement places its onset at Avon Park in the autumn of 1944, before combat. The 1959 letter is capable of two readings and settles neither.
what_we_dont: Which of the two readings the examiner meant, and when the injury began.
what_might_answer_it: The VA claim file C-1,302,621; the sworn statement's witness, if named.
evidence_needed: The examiner's rating decision, or the claim file.
